## 14 Reaction and Time

The fold genealogy is:

    triangle -> cell -> carrier -> ElementBasis

Post-element Universe time is the unfolding of admitted configuration genealogy:

    Universe_w
      -> admitted reaction
      -> Universe_w+1

Horizontal reaction:

    rearranges active relations
    preserves the exact element multiset
    preserves K_id_min

Vertical reaction:

    changes a governed multiset relation
    preserves K_id_min
    supplies a specific governed vertical witness
    admits the target configuration

No vertical edge is created merely because a transformation is geometrically imaginable.

### 24.1 SELF_UNFOLDING_ELEMENT_BASIS_V1

Purpose:

    execute one unary fold recursively
    terminate only at intrinsic elemental closure
    produce the complete finite ElementBasis

Inputs:

    triangle genesis realization
    constitutive fold law
    carrier grammar
    elemental-closure predicate

Outputs:

    ElementBasis
    FoldGenealogyReceiptV1
    ElementalClosureReceiptV1

Forbidden:

    scale-specific fold functions
    element names as constructors
    host-selected stopping depth
    incomplete basis reported as complete

### 24.4 JUNCTION_REACTION_ALGEBRA_V1

Purpose:

    derive admissible relations from shape
    materialize horizontal reactions in the fiber
    type every proposed vertical reaction through K_id_min

Inputs:

    ElementBasis
    intrinsic junction ports
    Governed Reaction Lattice
    admissibility predicate
    K_id_min preservation law

Outputs:

    JunctionRelationSetV1
    HorizontalReactionFiberV1
    governed vertical-reaction candidates only when witnessed

Forbidden:

    recipe-table reactions
    automatic vertical edges
    fallback joins or meets
    host-authored compatibility

"F2_CARRIER" -> NO IN TOGETHER {
        kind: "FOLD_REALIZATION_V1"
        realization_kind: "F3_ELEMENT_POLYHEDRA_BASIS"
        structural_whole: carrier_grammar.geometric_element_types
        genealogy_verdict: carrier_grammar.element_basis_genealogy_verdict
        structure_verdict: carrier_grammar.element_basis_structure_verdict
        fold_identity: "SELF_UNFOLDING_FOLD_V1"
        parent_realization_digest: current.realization_digest
        realization_digest: TOGETHER {
          law: "SELF_UNFOLDING_FOLD_V1"
          parent: current.realization_digest
          realization: "F3_ELEMENT_POLYHEDRA_BASIS"
          geometric_types: carrier_grammar.geometric_element_types
        }.sha256
      }
      "F3_ELEMENT_POLYHEDRA_BASIS" -> NO IN current
      _ -> NO IN fold_obligation_v1.call("NOT_SAME", "REALIZATION_KIND", current)
    }
    NO IN successor

STEP_FABRIC(Σ_t):

  program := Σ_t.program
  snapshot := immutable(Σ_t.state)

  1. SNAPSHOT

  2. EVALUATE
     active_t :=
       { c | payload_state(c,snapshot) = ADMITTED(frame,_) }

     cell_results_t :=
       { c ↦ evaluate(c, program, snapshot)
         FOR EVERY c ∈ active_t }

  3. PROPAGATE
     route_results_t :=
       { r ↦ propagate(r, program, snapshot, cell_results_t)
         FOR EVERY r ∈ program.routes }

     canonicalize route results by route identity

  4. RUNTIME GOVERNANCE
     governance_results_t :=
       govern_runtime(
         program,
         snapshot,
         route_results_t,
         imported_V3_2_authority
       )

  5. SIMULTANEOUS COMMIT
     state_{t+1} :=
       simultaneous_commit(
         snapshot,
         cell_results_t,
         route_results_t,
         governance_results_t
       )

  RETURN (program, state_{t+1})
